group_key_rule: The group key of a row is the JSON object (json.dumps with sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, default=str) built from the configured group columns in the order they were given; null group values are handled separately according to null_group_policy. The group key digest is sha256(key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest() of the canonical JSON string. Digests and traversal orders never participate in random decisions.
